origin_model.markers_commercial: gummei 450/xx, real-subscriber IMSI, NR band n78, real MME group (!=2), registered TAC !=7
origin_model.markers_test: PLMN 00101, registered TAC 7, Open5GS core (MME code 1 + group 2), or SIB1-TAC 57 + LTE Band 8
origin_model.rule: any commercial marker -> commercial; else any test marker -> test/lab; else unknown
